title: Single cell sequencing of IgAN patients
description: To study the functions of PBMC subpopulations in the pathogenesis and progression of IgA nephropathy Overall design: we performed single-cell RNA sequencing of tonsillar cells and PBMCs from patient with IgA nephropathy on days 0 (pre-operation), 7, and 150.
